sections.eyebrow: Who We Are | Advanced Electricity Infrastructure
sections.heading: About Us
sections.body: BaSuka (meaning 'house of women's in Mooré) is a women-led energy and infrastructure company working to strengthen Africa's energy security, beginning in Burkina Faso. Our generation-first strategy starts with planned utility-scale power plants and new dispatchable generation capacity to support national electricity supply, industry, businesses, and communities. From this foundation, we aim to expand into electric hubs, smart energy services, and SIRATM battery-swapping solutions for mobility and productive use. Led by Carolyn Wright, BaSuka combines infrastructure development with workforce training and women's leadership to build lasting local capability across West Africa.

sections.heading: Our Mission & Vision
sections.intro: Building a Sovereign Energy Future for Africa

items.title: Our Mission
items.body: BaSuka Energy delivers reliable, affordable electricity across Africa — beginning with a generation-first foundation of new dispatchable generation capacity, then extending through smart, portable, swappable batteries that power electric mobility, businesses, and homes.

items.title: Our Vision
items.body: BaSuka Energy will build an integrated, customer-driven energy platform that supports energy sovereignty, industrialization, and inclusive growth — delivering reliable power for the national grid and clean, smart electricity services where grid access fails.

items.title: Inclusive → Women-Led Workforce
items.body: The Yennenga Warriors are BaSuka's professional talent pipeline, building practical capabilities in health and safety, site operations, customer engagement, storage support, and future energy services.

items.title: Reliable → Generation First
items.body: Planned utility-scale power plants will provide the dependable electricity required by the national grid, industry, mining, agriculture, businesses, homes, and communities.

items.title: Responsible → Sustainable Development
items.body: High-efficiency, lower-emission technologies and disciplined environmental and social safeguards will guide the platform's development.

items.title: Professional → The 'Yennenga' Legacy
items.body: Rooted in the spirit of Burkina Faso's legendary warrior-princess. We drive local economic growth by empowering women as professional infrastructure leaders through the BaSuka Academy.

items.title: BaSuka Academy
items.body: Professional training for the women who run our stations.

sections.heading: We are seeking infrastructure funds, fuel and technology partners, engineering firms, and public-sector allies to build Africa's energy foundation
sections.body: BaSuka is developing an integrated infrastructure platform: dependable generation first, followed by smart-grid distribution, storage, swappable batteries, clean mobility, and energy services. We welcome collaborators who share the objective of dependable power and inclusive economic growth in Africa.
